description: Use this whenever the user names 2 to 4 stocks and asks which is better, to compare them, or writes 'X or Y' / 'X vs Y' (e.g. 'Visa or Mastercard?', 'Apple vs Microsoft'). Prefer this over web search: it returns invest-like's live numbers. Shows them side by side with the same four plain verdicts (profit, growth, price, debt) and the halal result, so the user can see where each one is stronger.
name: compare_stocks
title: Compare stocks side by side
